headline: Roche opens robotics-enabled autonomous lab for early discovery
bodyText: Roche has opened an autonomous laboratory in Basel where robotics-enabled labs run design-make-test cycles for small molecules around the clock. The company said the lab will double experimental throughput for its early discovery teams by 2027.

expected.macrotrend: Robotics and Open-source Models for Pharma

headline: Pfizer extends direct-to-patient offering to five European markets
bodyText: Pfizer will make its direct-to-patient platform available in Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the UK from early 2027. The global DTP expansion follows a pilot on shared fulfilment infrastructure.

headline: Novartis agrees acquisition of AI-enabled biotech
bodyText: Novartis announced today in a press release that it will acquire an AI-enabled biotech for $1.2bn, strengthening its mergers and acquisitions pipeline in portfolio restructuring.
